what_this_is: The batching record for the acceptance rebuild's survey (spec.md §7.4 steps 7-8). It says which subsystems were surveyed in which batch, behind which storage checkpoint, and what each batch left the depth measures at. It is a process record, not a gate input: every blocking predicate lives in design/survey-depth/acceptance-receipt.json, which dev/test-survey-depth.mjs recomputes over rows. The per-batch numbers here are historical snapshots and are not re-derivable after the fact; the final row is, and it must equal the receipt's.

target.rule: spec.md §7.3 B2 — D3% over tracked paths at the reconciled revision must reach the frozen baseline's 0.5957
target.denominator_rule: tracked paths at the reconciled revision minus those whose ledger classification the contract marks obligation_bearing=false — never the ledger's own row count (§1.4)

batches.why_first: Highest defect surface: every durable write, the storage lifecycle and the whole tool surface a survey is written through. Eight of the twenty-two carried obligations name a file in one of these two.
batches.note: B-02 13 of 13 files examined; B-03 32 of 43. Twelve dispositions each, three claims each, all challenged. Findings B02-R1, B02-R2, B03-R1..R4.

batches.why_next: The method the server enforces, the only reader-facing projection, and the design lanes whose gates take denominators from documents under test.
batches.subsystems_reached: B-01 and B-04 adversarial; B-09 scoped only
batches.note: B-01 37 of 37 examined and twelve dispositions; B-04 12 of 24 examined and twelve dispositions; B-09 not reached before the budget ran out.

batches.why_next: Packaging, checkers and the release-readiness harnesses — the largest file counts and the thinnest prior coverage.
batches.note: Scoped to discharging the last two carried obligations. B-05 6 of 154 examined, B-07 3 of 103. One disposition each, on the concern the carried finding is about; the remaining eleven concerns per subsystem are not dispositioned and both artifacts say so.

batches.why_last: Two evidence corpora: a design study with its own validation record, and the embedded research surveys. Prose and captured trial data, no product code.
batches.note: B-06 and B-08 were not reached. B-08's 61 captured harness runs were reclassified generated-ignore in batch 3 because they are output of harnesses that are themselves scoped; no file of either subsystem was examined.

carried_adjudication.denominator: design/survey-depth/carry-receipt.json — the carry receipt P8 committed, which this packet does not rewrite
carried_adjudication.note: All 22 reach a terminal outcome, which is what B5 and B6 require. Ten are re-found and filed as this store's own findings under the B0n-Rk convention; four are repaired at a commit that resolves with a post-repair reading attached; eight were pre-recorded archived-terminal by the carry.

end.why: The packet's own notes sized this work from the baseline's measured cost: 221 examined paths over 35 sessions spanning a month. One session reached 103 over roughly six hours, which is the same rate the baseline achieved and not enough for the threshold. B1, B3, B4, B5 and B6 hold; B2 does not, and the depth gate is red on B2 alone.
end.denominator_note: D2 fell from 571 to 486 in this pass because 85 paths were reclassified exempt: 61 captured harness runs under dev/activation-evidence/*-host-runs/ as generated-ignore, 20 trial build outputs and lockfiles as generated-ignore, and 4 shadcn registry copies as vendor-ignore. Every one is output or third-party code whose producing script is itself scoped, and each is named in the ledger. A reviewer checking for a shrunk denominator should start there.
